items.title: Should You Worry That IBM Has Gone Quiet On Its AI Total?
items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) used to hand investors a single number that made its AI push easy to check: the running dollar value of the generative-AI work it had won. That number is missing from the July 2026 call, though generative AI still turns up in the Consulting numbers. Where the figure went, and what management counts instead, is the more useful question.
